newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf crude tankers resume loadings at LOOP.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf crude tankers resume loadings at LOOP.

text.p: Oil tankers started unloading crude oil at the Louisiana Offshore Oil Port (LOOP) from late Tuesday, a LOOP official said Wednesday.
"Ships started to unload late Tuesday afternoon," the official said, earlier noting that berthings were dependent on the weather in the wake of former Tropical Storm Josephine.
Four or five tankers were reported lining up outside the port waiting to make deliveries.
Pipeline operations and deliveries were not affected by the delay in shipping.
The LOOP, located about 20 miles south of Grand Isle, Louisiana, is the only deep-water port in U.S. waters and has been shut since Saturday by heavy seas.
